text_block_list.text:
"Timid," "selfish," "hates the starting 
gate." Before her Make Debut, she 
attempted to overcome numerous weaknesses, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, Trainerrr... No, no, nooo. I don't 
wanna go into the gate...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! What if I just come out 
instead of going in? That's it! Let's go 
with that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look, that doesn't make any sense at all. 
How can you leave without ever going 
inside?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Traaaiineer~, do something about this~! 
Turbo wants to race, but Turbo hates the 
starting gate~!

"Above all, her 'gate hatred' was the 
first hurdle we had to clear. If she can't 
pass the gate exam, she can't even Make 
Debut in the first place..."

"Even so, her gate entry is always 
unstable, and depending on her mood, she 
either panics or acts up..."

To be honest, I was at my wit's end. It 
felt like her fundamental personality 
needed addressing, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. If it's okay with you, how 
about I introduce you to someone I know? A 
bit of a "pro."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Right. A girl who's super good at looking 
after and managing other Umamusume. People 
call her—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —The "Iron Lady"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, time to meet! Miss Iron Woman, 
over here!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"'The Iron Lady'... Quite a unique 
nickname. I certainly am sound in mind and 
body, but to be praised in such a way..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—My name is Ikuno Dictus. If it's about 
the management of Umamusume, I believe I 
can at least offer an opinion.
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you, Ikuno Dictus.
I'm counting on you, Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.text:
There are things only an Umamusume can 
understand about another Umamusume. I 
decided to have the perceptive Ikuno 
Dictus keep an eye on Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Take that, and that, and that! 
Hyaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"She's unimaginably restless. And quite 
timid, too..."

...She gave me another firm guarantee. 
Yet, judging by the gloom on her face, it 
seemed the solution wouldn't be easy after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In my assessment, Turbo-san's dislike of 
the starting gates stems from deep within 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
An innate timidness is, so to speak, a 
survival instinct. It is likely not 
something that will simply go away just by 
getting used to the starting gates.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! Turbo thought so too!

Twin Turbo looked strangely 
self-important. She listened to Ikuno 
Dictus's words and pondered them.

If familiarity won't solve it... I wonder 
if we really have no choice but to give 
her a complete personality overhaul.
choice_data_list: Zazen, therapy, that sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Zazen? Therapy? I don't really get it, 
but I have a bad feeling about this..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no no, Turbo wouldn't do something like 
that! 'Cause I'm Turbo!

Just as expected, Twin Turbo is reluctant. 
It might be worth letting her try, but 
something feels off...

This Umamusume is... "T-W-I-N T-U-R-B-O." 
Is something like that really going to fix 
her?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Mental training, is it? That is certainly 
standard practice. However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In my humble opinion, "there is a limit to 
improvement."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In the end, you can't make someone love 
what they hate. And forcing someone to do 
something they aren't convinced of yields 
little result...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe that is what makes us human. 
And... what makes us Umamusume.

I nodded at Ikuno Dictus's words. It seems 
she isn't... as cold as iron after all.

She's calm and collected, yet truly 
empathetic to others' feelings. That's 
exactly why she can be trusted.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So, what are you gonna do, Trainer?

Correcting flaws is impossible. If that is 
the case—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, gate training after all~? No matter 
how many times I do it, Turbo will never 
like gates~!
choice_data_list: It's fine if you keep hating me

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, you still hate it?

—Let me explain. Once you enter the gate, 
simply chant 'hate, hate, hate' in your 
mind and let that feeling swell.

"Whether positive or negative, energy is 
still energy. If that's the case..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
(U-Uuuugh, uuuugh...!! I hate it, I hate 
it... I really hate the gates~!)
(Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "No waaaaay!! Let's goooooooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, what was that burst of speed just 
now!? Has Turbo ever gotten out of the 
gate that perfectly before!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer, Trainer, Trainer!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo did it! I totally nailed the start 
dash! Pretty awesome, right!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, YESSSSS!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I don't like the gate, but enduring 
it even while hating it isn't so bad 
either.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The feeling of relief afterward is so 
addictive! I might be kind of hooked!

"A sadist with a masochistic streak. That 
is Twin Turbo's true nature. Deep down in 
her heart, she relishes suffering... and 
yearns for release."

By making the most of her personality, she 
managed to overcome her biggest hurdle: 
her hatred of starting gates.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Splendid work, Trainer. To turn 
Turbo-san's weakness into her greatest 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Management is quite a profound subject, 
isn't it?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, this is thanks to Ikuno's advice 
too.

Yeah, this is all thanks to Ikuno's 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Mine...?

Because Ikuno Dictus stated flatly that 
"there is a limit to improvements," I was 
able to make a bold decision myself.

"Having someone to talk things over with 
truly makes an enormous difference."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. If I was able to be of even a 
little help, then I'm glad.
choice_data_list:
If it's okay, could I keep asking you for 
help from now on?
If it's okay, can I keep counting on you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
――? Even from now on? Managing Turbo-san, 
that is?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it'd really help if you could back 
me up.

Yeah, having your support would be a huge 
help.

text_block_list.text:
Guiding the troublesome Twin Turbo to 
success seems impossible alone. In that 
case...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'm honored by your 
recognition. And—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I'd be glad to keep helping out. I want 
to learn all sorts of things through you, 
Turbo-san."

—A handshake beneath the moon. Yes, this 
was a bond forged to conquer the Twinkle 
Series together.

I've found one reliable source of strength 
that will support Twin Turbo.
